utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the date, time, and what repairs are needed before I can help plan it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m with you — I don’t have those details yet, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like the repair drive is really coming together — how can I help?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — if you can help, I just need to confirm the date, time, and what repairs we’re collecting for.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help—what do you need me to bring or fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’ll actually spread the word about the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what repairs are needed for the drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this afternoon—are you still good to help? I’ll send the exact repairs list next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I meant to keep an eye on that. Has anything changed yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not yet, but I’m still waiting on the final list and timing from Eli. Once that’s set, I’ll spread the word to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Folks around here usually pitch in when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll send the final list and timing as soon as they’re set, and we can keep it organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’ll share the updated list and timing so everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Rosa. I’m still in for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the status and note any changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can pass along a few updates and keep it low-key. Just let me know which practical bits you want me to cover.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be great, Nell. Could you just keep track of who’s bringing what and let me know if anything shifts?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Rey—just give me a shout when you’re ready and I’ll have my tools handy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I really appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as something comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. If anything comes up, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping the supplies list organized for the repair drive, so tell me what you still need and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—thanks, Oren. Meet me at the community shed, and I’ll hand you the first set of repairs to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’m out running errands anyway, so I can swing by the community shed and take the first batch with me if that helps.
